title: Unihertz Atom Bluetooth Connection Lost Dexcom G6
symptom: After the phone is out of range from the Dexcom G6 sensor for about 15-20 minutes, xDrip gets stuck in the 'Scanning' state and cannot reconnect; the only way to reconnect is to reboot the phone. Restarting the collector does not resolve it.
cause: The Unihertz manufacturer's power saving additions to Android shut down xDrip (PowerSaveService forceStopThirdApp for com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip) even when background activity and battery optimization exemptions are enabled.
fix: Use Unihertz battery optimization clean-up: set Battery Saver to off, set xDrip to 'not optimized' under Settings > Apps & Notifications > Advanced > Special app access > Battery Optimization, and under Settings > Smart Assistant > App Blocker untoggle Start Blocker, Background Blocker and Background Cleanup for xDrip.
evidence_quote: my initial findings are that the problems are due to the manufacturers power saving additions to android which shut down xDrip.
